describes: Current plugin store/mirror/pending coverage for all25 update+2 measurement reconciliation runs, plus H3 disappearance.

cases.name: reconcile/loaded
cases.covers: A confirmed full load replaces existing geometry and adds new records without a removed loaded message.

cases.name: reconcile/hydrated-reaps
cases.covers: Reload disappearance forgets selected/hovered/edited records and preserves surviving selection.

cases.name: reconcile/hydrated-bump
cases.covers: Full refresh advances surviving picture versions and discards grouped stale parts.

cases.name: reconcile/hydrated-keeps-dragged
cases.covers: Current H3 deliberately forgets a drag target that disappears during refresh, rather than retaining a stale dragged record.

cases.name: reconcile/hydrated-nothing-reaped
cases.covers: Refreshing identical records preserves valid selection and all records.

cases.name: reconcile/hydrated-empty-hover
cases.covers: An empty mirror has no hovered/editor refs; refresh and text.end keep the empty session safe.

cases.name: reconcile/hydrated-keeps-surviving-hover
cases.covers: A full refresh preserves hover and editor refs still in the mirror while removing another record.

cases.name: reconcile/created
cases.covers: A pending free text can be selected and edited by its final born ref; confirmation keeps both refs stable.

cases.name: reconcile/created-index-ref
cases.covers: A baseIndex read keeps its name while a new annotation is born under a reserved objectNumber; no mutable index remap exists.

cases.name: reconcile/created-mid-move
cases.covers: Current stable-born move: confirm; gesture begins before the engine confirms the create.

cases.name: reconcile/created-mid-handle
cases.covers: Current stable-born handle: confirm; gesture begins before the engine confirms the create.

cases.name: reconcile/created-mid-rotate
cases.covers: Current stable-born rotate: confirm; gesture begins before the engine confirms the create.

cases.name: reconcile/created-mid-poly-draft
cases.covers: An earlier pending create confirms while a polygon draft is active; the polygon keeps its points and can finish.

cases.name: reconcile/created-relationships
cases.covers: Reply and group children name their pending parent by its final ref before either engine confirmation.

cases.name: reconcile/created-then-echo-mid-move
cases.covers: Current stable-born move: confirm; gesture begins before the engine confirms the create.

cases.name: reconcile/created-unknown
cases.covers: A current remote create without a local pending entry adds exactly one baked record and keeps the local selection.

cases.name: reconcile/create-failed
cases.covers: A refused pending create leaves unrelated mirror records and selection intact.

cases.name: reconcile/create-failed-mid-move
cases.covers: Current stable-born move: refuse; gesture begins before the engine confirms the create.

cases.name: reconcile/create-failed-mid-handle
cases.covers: Current stable-born handle: refuse; gesture begins before the engine confirms the create.

cases.name: reconcile/upsert
cases.covers: Actual confirmed updates preserve order and advance picture version only when changed is true.

cases.name: reconcile/upsert-while-dragging
cases.covers: A current confirmed update of a surviving target keeps the real active gesture and selection safe.

cases.name: reconcile/upsert-while-rotating
cases.covers: A current confirmed update of a surviving target keeps the real active gesture and selection safe.

cases.name: reconcile/upsert-while-group
cases.covers: A current confirmed update of a surviving target keeps the real active gesture and selection safe.

cases.name: reconcile/upsert-while-marquee
cases.covers: A real marquee continues across confirmed updates and selects from the current mirrored geometry.

cases.name: reconcile/bump-ap
cases.covers: Picture epochs follow the actual engine appearance verdict; an inert update does not invalidate the raster.

cases.name: reconcile/measurement-create-annot
cases.covers: Current create uses tool defaults, explicit endings, flags and URI target without a removed createAnnot message.

cases.name: reconcile/measurement-hydrated-under-caption-drag
cases.covers: A real current caption gesture survives a refresh that keeps its target, then synchronous forget ends it when the next refresh removes it.

cases.name: reconcile/h3-confirmed-deletion-mid-move
cases.covers: Current stable-born move: delete; gesture begins before the engine confirms the create.

cases.name: reconcile/h3-mirror-disappearance-mid-handle
cases.covers: Current stable-born handle: disappear; gesture begins before the engine confirms the create.

cases.name: reconcile/h3-pending-stamp-confirm
cases.covers: A placed stamp uses the real resource/preview path, starts a move before acknowledgement, and confirms or is forgotten on refusal.

cases.name: reconcile/h3-pending-stamp-refuse
cases.covers: A placed stamp uses the real resource/preview path, starts a move before acknowledgement, and confirms or is forgotten on refusal.

cases.name: reconcile/h3-pending-caption-confirm
cases.covers: A newly born measurement caption is dragged before create confirmation and commits its offset afterwards without losing identity.
